title: Bullish On Beaches
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Bullish on Beaches”, a luxury 6-bed, 6 full & 3 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 24 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Private Resort-Style Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Elevator - 6 Seater Golf Cart Included - 6 Adult Bicycles Included - New Construction - Short Walk to the Beach Towering above the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, stands “Bullish on Beaches”. A magnificent vacation rental situated to pay homage to sunsets and crashing waves. Built around a private courtyard and spanning three stories, this home boasts six bedrooms and seven and a half bathrooms. Adorned with Moroccan tile, modern fixtures, and stylish finishes this contemporary beach retreat will leave all desires satisfied. Greeted by a private courtyard with a tranquil pool and spa, “Bullish on Beaches” welcomes the largest of families and groups. The courtyard is accompanied by a contemporary floor to ceiling outdoor shower perfect for washing the sand away before plunging into the refreshing pool. An inviting living area with a gas fireplace and natural wood beam ceilings is the perfect place for relaxation. While the large chef’s kitchen and connecting dining room are an absolute culinary paradise, granting gatherings around home cooked delicacies. A first-floor bedroom with ensuite bathroom sits to the west of the home, complimented by beautiful tile and a walk-in closet. Additions to the first floor include an oversized laundry/utility room and a half bath. Ascending to the second floor, either by a lit staircase or elevator, is a large media room ideal for movies and gaming, complete with a wet bar. Along the naturally lit hallway are two guest suites both with private adjoining bathrooms. The second floor also consists of a playful bunk room with two queen over queen bunks, two twin over twin bunks and a private bath. At the end of the hall rests yet another suite with a private balcony and spa-like bathroom accented with exquisite light fixtures and double vanities. Additions to the second floor include a half bath off the media room, laundry room, and a French door Juliette balcony overlooking the courtyard. Leaving the best for last is the third story. Welcomed by a serene living room decorated with lush furnishings, sliding glass doors flood the room with sunlight and lead to a majestic balcony with a gas fireplace and wet bar. This is the perfect location to enjoy refreshments or hors ’d’oeuvres as the sun dips behind the horizon and the sky turns hypnotizing hues of pink, orange and purple. French doors unveil the heavenly third floor master. The master bath is unfathomable with a soaking tub enclosed in a dual shower accented by bench seating and floor to ceiling tile. Additions to the third floor include a study and half bath. Steps from the home is a public beach access with bike racks. ___________________ Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Primary Suite - Private bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Second Floor King Bedroom with Twin/Twin Bunk - Private Bathroom with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Bunk Room - Two Queen over Queen bunks and One Twin over Twin Bunks - Private Bathroom with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Third Floor King Primary Suite - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub *There is currently construction nearby*
